clue.text: Lawman in plain clothes

definitions.meaning: a Muslim scholar who gives rulings on Islamic law
civilian dress worn by someone off duty

explanation.surface: A police officer working undercover, out of uniform.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lawman' suggests a sheriff or detective, but it is a religious jurist; 'in' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses are dictionary meanings: an Islamic legal expert, and civilian dress worn by a serviceman off duty.

clue.text: Lead article, for example, shows Labour supporting leader of miners and others

indicators.note: in a down clue the labour word sits under the rest, holding it up
the first letter of the word miners

parts.note: et al is Latin for and others
work means labour

explanation.surface: An editorial praising the Labour Party backing the miners' union boss.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lead article' suggests an editorial; it is an object made of lead.
explanation.definitionFit: Metalwork means objects crafted from metal, and lead is one such metal.

clue.text: Half-heartedly attacked criminal

indicators.note: the centre of the phrase has a double letter, and one of the pair goes

parts.note: fell on means set upon

explanation.surface: A lawbreaker set about someone without much effort.
explanation.definitionFit: A felon is someone who has committed a serious crime.

clue.text: Procrastinator's confession? He's a heathen

definitions.meaning: a dawdler's admission, read as three words: I'll do it at a later time

explanation.surface: A habitual delayer admits he is a pagan.
explanation.walkthrough: Split the answer as I DO LATER for the first reading; 'He's a' is link.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who worships idols is a pagan in the eyes of monotheists.

clue.text: Clever enough to work out joke

parts.note: wise enough means sensible or clever
to crack a code or problem is to work it out

explanation.surface: Someone quick-witted enough to solve the riddle behind a gag.
explanation.definitionFit: A wisecrack is a smart, flippant remark, a type of quip.

clue.text: Extra large

definitions.meaning: in cricket a ... is a ball bowled out of the batsman's reach, giving an extra run

explanation.walkthrough: In cricket, extras are runs not scored off the bat; a wide is one kind.
explanation.definitionFit: Broad in extent, and a cricket delivery penalised as unplayable.

clue.text: Belligerent chap who initiates court action?

definitions.meaning: a man in the fighting forces
in tennis, a player who serves starts each point on court

explanation.walkthrough: 'court action' suggests a lawsuit; it is tennis.
explanation.definitionFit: A member of the armed forces; also, jokingly, the player who starts a tennis rally.

clue.text: Put it in rodent's hole

indicators.note: the word it goes inside the rodent word

parts.note: a cavy is a guinea pig, a South American rodent

explanation.surface: Push it into the rat's burrow.
explanation.definitionFit: A cavity is a hollow space, such as one in a tooth.

clue.text: Collection of states in the Commonwealth

definitions.text: Collection of states in the Commonwealth

parts.words: Collection of states in the Commonwealth
parts.note: a federation of states that is a Commonwealth member, and is itself officially styled a Commonwealth

explanation.definitionFit: The country is a federation of six states, formally a Commonwealth, and belongs to the Commonwealth of Nations.

clue.text: Native of 7 raised in style of Roger

indicators.note: in a down clue the letters read upwards

parts.note: a la means in the manner of
roger is radio slang for okay, received

explanation.surface: An Australian brought up in the manner of someone called Roger.
explanation.walkthrough: Up turns ALAOK into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: The koala is a marsupial found only in that country.

clue.text: Difficult task for noble in relation to king

indicators.note: the noble is placed inside the word for relation, cutting it open

parts.note: a relation is a telling or narrative, a tale
a lord is a nobleman
R is the abbreviation for king (Latin rex)

explanation.surface: A tough job for an aristocrat when dealing with the monarch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'relation' looks like a family member, but here it is a story told, TALE.
explanation.definitionFit: A tall order is an idiom for a request that is unreasonably hard to fulfil.

clue.text: View biographical details about son

indicators.note: the biographical details go around the son, enclosing him

parts.note: a vita (as in curriculum vitae) is a brief account of a life

explanation.surface: Looking over a CV that describes someone's boy.
explanation.definitionFit: A vista is a pleasing distant prospect, a synonym of a scenic outlook.

clue.text: New driver with a high-class vehicle

parts.note: L is the learner plate shown by a novice driver in Britain
and means together with
U means upper-class, a British usage

explanation.surface: A learner motorist given a posh car.
explanation.walkthrough: In Britain a learner driver displays an L plate, and U describes upper-class speech or manners.
explanation.definitionFit: A landau is a four-wheeled horse-drawn carriage with a folding hood, a kind of conveyance.

clue.text: Flower featured in part of London street song

parts.note: W1 is the London postal district of the West End, read as the letters WI
an aria is a solo song in opera

explanation.surface: A bloom that appears in a ballad sung on a London road.
explanation.walkthrough: W1 is London's central West End postcode; the digit 1 is read as the letter I.
explanation.definitionFit: Wistaria, also spelt wisteria, is a climbing plant with drooping lilac blossoms.

clue.text: Catholic churchmen can produce this material

parts.note: catholic in lower case means wide-ranging, broad
the cloth means the clergy

explanation.surface: Roman Catholic priests can make this fabric.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Catholic' suggests the Church but means broad in sympathy.
explanation.definitionFit: Broadcloth is a fine woollen or cotton fabric, a type of textile.

clue.text: Girl, lacking experience, put in the shade

parts.note: Olive is a girl's name
green means raw or inexperienced

explanation.surface: A naive young woman is outshone by others.
explanation.walkthrough: 'put in the shade' reads as outshine, but 'shade' alone is the definition, a colour; 'put in the' is link.
explanation.definitionFit: Olive green is a dull yellowish-green colour, a hue.

clue.text: Rash trouble examined

parts.note: ill means harm or misfortune
judged means assessed

explanation.surface: A skin eruption is looked at by a doctor.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rash' looks like a skin complaint, but it is the adjective.
explanation.definitionFit: An ill-judged act is unwise or reckless.

clue.text: Cut the cold insolence!

parts.note: C is the abbreviation for cold, as on a tap
lip is informal for cheeky talk

explanation.surface: An exasperated parent telling a child to stop the frosty backchat.
explanation.definitionFit: To clip is to trim or snip something shorter.

clue.text: Person trying to follow US author is minor writer

indicators.note: in the clue the person comes after the author, so the author goes first

parts.note: Edgar Allan Poe was an American writer
a taster tries food or drink

explanation.surface: A wannabe imitating an American novelist is a lesser scribbler.
explanation.definitionFit: A poetaster is an inferior poet, a versifier of little talent.

clue.text: Allowed silence to be broken by daughter

indicators.note: the word silence is broken up into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A girl was permitted to break the quiet.
explanation.definitionFit: Licensed means officially permitted.

clue.text: Skirt not on woman — left in tub

indicators.note: the letter for left is put inside the word for tub

parts.note: a kit is a small wooden tub or pail, an old sense

explanation.surface: A skirt, not being worn, abandoned in the bath.
explanation.walkthrough: KIT for a wooden tub is an old word for a pail used for fish or butter.
explanation.definitionFit: The kilt is the pleated tartan garment worn by Scotsmen, a skirt for a man.

clue.text: This territory's a preserve, in a sense

indicators.note: the preserve goes inside the word for sense, splitting it

parts.note: the palate is the sense of taste
to tin food is to preserve it in a can

explanation.surface: A region described as a nature reserve, more or less.
explanation.walkthrough: 'preserve' suggests a reserve or jam, but it is the verb TIN.
explanation.definitionFit: A palatinate was a territory ruled by a count palatine, a sort of province.

clue.text: Oriental's companion recollected his age

indicators.note: gathered together again in a new order, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: An Eastern partner remembered how old he was.
explanation.walkthrough: 'recollected' reads as remembered, but means re-collected.
explanation.definitionFit: A geisha is a Japanese hostess trained to entertain men.

clue.text: Girl revealing disposition to husband well

definitions.meaning: to husband resources is to manage them thriftily; this is the quality of careful management

explanation.surface: A young woman shows she will look after her spouse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'husband' is a verb here, meaning to manage economically, not a spouse; 'revealing' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names a cautious, thrifty habit of mind as well as being a female forename.

clue.text: Pain round one side put down to crash

indicators.note: the word for pain goes around the side letter

parts.note: a pang is a sudden sharp pain
R is right, one side

explanation.surface: Ache about one flank attributed to a collision.
explanation.definitionFit: Prang is RAF slang for a crash, especially of a vehicle or aircraft.

clue.text: Burnt halves switched in this main area

indicators.note: the two halves of the word for burnt swap places

parts.note: seared means scorched

explanation.surface: Scorched pieces are swapped around in some ocean region.
explanation.walkthrough: 'main' is the poetic word for the open sea.
explanation.definitionFit: The body of water between Africa and Arabia is a stretch of the ocean.

clue.text: Jeer wolf

definitions.meaning: to wolf food is to gobble it

explanation.definitionFit: Two verbs: to mock scornfully, and to eat greedily.

clue.text: Instruments, collectively, in an engaging piece

definitions.meaning: kit or equipment as a whole
a toothed wheel that engages with another

explanation.definitionFit: Equipment in general, and a cog that meshes with another in machinery.

clue.text: Have a say before one's given protection

parts.note: eg (for example) is signalled by 'say'
I is one, and 's adds S

explanation.surface: Speaking up before someone is granted cover.
explanation.walkthrough: 'say' stands for EG, as in 'for example'; 'Have', 'before' and 'given' are links.
explanation.definitionFit: Under someone's aegis means under their sponsorship or shield.

clue.text: Send off, in public? Go too far

indicators.note: the dismissal word goes inside the word for public

parts.note: overt means done openly
shoo means drive away

explanation.surface: Dismissing someone openly could be excessive.
explanation.definitionFit: To overshoot is to pass beyond a target, exceeding it.

clue.text: Sponsor making contribution to Trinity?

definitions.meaning: a person who presents a child at baptism
the first person of the Christian Trinity, read as a phrase

explanation.surface: A backer giving money to a Cambridge college.
explanation.walkthrough: Trinity is also a Cambridge college, which the surface suggests; 'making' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A baptismal sponsor is a godparent; separately, God the Father is one member of the Holy Trinity.

clue.text: Less capable in audition -not taking a bow

indicators.note: the letter A is left out of the word

parts.note: deafer means less able to hear

explanation.surface: A worse performer at a tryout refuses to take a curtain call.
explanation.walkthrough: 'audition' is the act of hearing, not a tryout.
explanation.definitionFit: To defer is to yield or submit to someone, as one does in bowing to their wishes.
